notes: This is the base PLM 20K44 with the 'embedded patch panel' Neutrik speakON output configuration (2x NLT4 + 1x NLT8), as distinct from the fixed-connector PLM 20K44 SP (speakON-only) and PLM 20K44 BP (4x binding-post pairs) SKUs sold by some retailers. Data taken from Lab.gruppen's own official spec sheet (item no. TDS-PLM+_V2, dated 28.01.2015), mirrored via a distributor (prodgsystems.com) after the manufacturer's own labgruppen.com product page returned HTTP 404 during retrieval. Content matches Lab.gruppen's branding/format exactly and is corroborated by independent retailer/distributor listings (B&H, Kling & Freitag) describing the same connector set (4x XLR analog in, 2x XLR AES in x2ch each, 2x RJ45 etherCON, 32A powerCON). etherCON grade inferred as eth-1g from 'Auto 100/1000' spec (Gigabit-capable); these Ethernet ports also carry Lake Controller monitoring/control (DLM protocol) in addition to Dante audio. Rack depth is 424mm rail-to-rear-panel (498mm overall including handles); weight 17kg. If the BP or SP variant is what's actually being modeled, swap the 3 speakON outputs for either 4x binding-post pairs (BP variant) or drop the binding posts entirely (SP variant, speakON-only, same as documented here).
